text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Passing by the library, I catch a glimpse of
Sweep Tosho combing the
shelves for
something.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I found it! This is definitely it. I knew I saw
it the last time I was here!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hmph, Grandma tells me that all the time!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, I gotta hurry before she
catches up!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Thorns, o thorns, entwine! ☆

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text: I've finally found you, Sweep Tosho!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! What gives?! Why isn't my ensnaring
spell working?!

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I see your trainer is with you as well.
Let me explain.

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho didn't do her homework, and
when I tried to get her to
attend makeup
lessons, she ran away.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Of course I did! Who would want to stay at school for that?! If I don't wanna, I don't wanna!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Anyways, why isn't my spell working?! I'm
sure I followed all the steps
in this book!

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho, hear me out. I'm not giving
you homework so you have
more busywork
to do.

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
In your future as a competitor, balancing
training with your studies
will be very
important. That's why I'm giving you
homework now, so
you can get used to it.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Blah blah blah—who are you to give me
orders?! If I don't wanna, I'm
not gonna!

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text: Sweep Tosho!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Clearly, these two have forgotten to use
their inside voices. Sensing
the judging
stares of those around us, I realize it's my
time to
intervene.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Back in my office, I suggest to Sweep
Tosho that maybe doing her
homework
wouldn't be so bad. Heck, it might even
be fun!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Homework, schomework—even my
familiar's getting on my case now! I

thought you were helping me by getting
that teacher outta my hair!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Then why don't you do it for me, familiar?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: And why not?! A familiar HAS to listen to their master, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's no stopping her once she's
throwing a tantrum. She's
completely
honest with her feelings, and has no
patience for things
she isn't interested in.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In a sudden flash of genius, I recall a
recent moment when she showed
a liking
to something.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I found it! This is definitely it. I knew I saw
it the last time I was here!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hey, what're you all quiet for?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You mean like writing the answers
with magic? Hmm, you might
be onto
something.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Casting a spell on myself? Explain,
familiar.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that just extra steps though? So
basically... you want me to cast a
speed
spell, right?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Well... whatever. Sounds kinda fun! Here I
go!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Spell well—excel! Alstroemeria! ☆

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Okay, now for the first problem... Wow, it
really is a piece of cake
now!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As if truly enchanted, Sweep begins to
plow through her homework at
an
impressive pace.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
For this problem... Urgh, I can feel my
speed dropping! "Solve like the
wind!
Alstroemeria! ☆"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Wow, I can't believe I'm already done! Do
you see now, familiar? This
is the power of
Magical Girl Sweepy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When she makes up her mind to do
something, she really does do it
better
than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, praise me more! I can't wait to shut
that teacher up! C'mon, let's
go find her—I
bet she'll be shocked!

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
A perfect score. Good grief, I knew you
could do it if you applied
yourself, so
please stop running away all the time.
Also...

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
Your trainer helped you, right? Make sure
to say thank you later,
okay?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Geeeeez! She should've been stunned by
my magic—not fawning over
my familiar!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
In any case, with magic on my side,
homework is a problem of the
past.
Goodbye extra lessons, hello freedom!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As she says that, her eyes light up with
newfound motivation. When it
comes to
doing what she loves, you won't find a
harder worker than
Sweep Tosho.
